title: Case Studies Overview
meta_description: 36 anonymized client engagements across 12 industries — with challenge, solution architecture and measured outcomes for every program.

blocks.x: Thirty-six anonymized engagements across the industries we serve. The identities stay behind NDA; the numbers are the clients' own, reproduced with permission, and the method that moved them is documented on every page.

Each case reads the same way an audit would: the situation, what measurement exposed, what went into production, and the measured delta. Baselines were signed before any build; the figures come from the client's own systems.
Read the case closest to your sector, then bring your metric to a briefing — the diagnostic that locked each baseline takes two weeks.
Talk to the team that runs the section map above in production — the briefing is technical by design, and the first one costs nothing but the hour.
